title: Review role-system design and derive MAP improvement roadmap
description: Review /home/mellow/Projects/MultiAgentProject/roles_in_MAP_system.md end-to-end, emphasizing the mature architecture near the end. Compare its role, skill, routing, run-manifest, evidence, retrieval, and memory proposals against current reusable MAP behavior. Produce a grounded adoption roadmap that distinguishes existing capability, useful extension, risky over-design, and concrete implementation sequence.
acceptance_criteria: The review explains the document's progression from persona prompts to operational role contracts and identifies the strongest late-stage ideas.
Each major proposal is mapped to current MAP evidence as already present, partial, missing, or intentionally rejected, with file/script references.
Recommendations are prioritized by behavior and failure-mode impact, not by adding documentation or directories.
The roadmap separates near-term changes from experiments and deferred architecture, and states risks, dependencies, and verification for each.
The report explicitly identifies ideas MAP should not adopt as written and why.
